items.title: Polands CERT Warns of Active Exploitation of Critical Zimbra Collaboration Suite Flaw
items.description: CERT Polska confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-73570, a critical unauthenticated RCE in Zimbra Collaboration Suite patched on July 20. CERT Polska, Polands national computer emergency response team, confirmed this week that threat actors are actively exploiting a critical vulnerability in Zimbra Collaboration Suite tracked as CVE-2026-73570. The flaw allows unauthenticated remote code execution and was []

ttps.justification: Technique applies because: RCE, unauthenticated. The Exploit Public-Facing Application technique is relevant because this vulnerability's attack mechanism aligns with Initial Access phase behavior described in ATT&CK v16.
ttps.observed_behavior: Based on the vulnerability description, an adversary exploiting 'Poland’s CERT Warns of Active Exploitation of Critical Zimbra Collaboration Suit' would employ Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190) during the Initial Access phase. The exploitation mechanism directly enables the Initial Access objective.
ttps.detection_hint: Alert on unexpected process spawning from web server processes (IIS, Apache, nginx, Tomcat). Monitor for shell commands (cmd.exe, bash, sh) launched by web service accounts.
ttps.kql_example: DeviceProcessEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ('w3wp.exe','httpd','nginx','tomcat') and FileName has_any ('cmd.exe','powershell.exe','bash','sh')

ttps.justification: Technique applies because: code execution, RCE. The Command and Scripting Interpreter technique is relevant because this vulnerability's attack mechanism aligns with Execution phase behavior described in ATT&CK v16.
ttps.observed_behavior: Based on the vulnerability description, an adversary exploiting 'Poland’s CERT Warns of Active Exploitation of Critical Zimbra Collaboration Suit' would employ Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059) during the Execution phase. The exploitation mechanism directly enables the Execution objective.
ttps.detection_hint: Monitor for unusual parent-child process relationships. Alert on PowerShell with encoded commands, downloading content, or disabling security features.
